items.review_rationale: Reviewed normality using invariance under each conjugation gNg^-1 in ambient group, taking inverses in group and equality of subgroup sets.

references.context: Group product involving g, element n in N and inverse of g.
Set {g n g^{-1}:n in N} of group elements.

references.phrase: equality with N for every g
references.context: Conjugation by any group element preserves subgroup N as a set.

references.disposition: Conjugation-invariance is an equivalent condition, not a definition dependency back onto itself.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed normality via one-sided inclusion gNg^-1 subset N for all g, including inverse g^-1, which forces reverse inclusion and equality.

references.context: Set obtained by conjugating every n in N with given g in G.
Condition is demanded for each g and its inverse so both containment directions hold.

references.disposition: Condition for a single g alone would not imply normality; here it holds for every g.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed ordinary generating function as real-valued map on exactly the domain of convergence of associated power series, with no assumption of full-line convergence.

references.context: A sequence of real numbers indexed by all nonnegative integers.
Infinite series with coefficients a_n, evaluated at real variable z.
Subset of R formed by exactly those inputs z for which the resulting real series converges.

references.disposition: Real-valued ordinary generating function here is defined on its convergence domain only.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed quotient group construction using left cosets of a normal subgroup and induced multiplication (aN)(bN)=(ab)N, requiring well-definedness independent of representatives.

references.context: Collection of distinct left cosets of N in G.
Binary operation on coset classes induced by multiplication of representatives.
If representative a or b changes within its coset, resulting product coset is unchanged due to normality.

references.disposition: For general non-normal subgroups, left cosets do not inherit this multiplication as a group.
